class.name: GraphScript
class.brief_description: A script made of steps joined by wires, stored as an [code].ograph[/code] file.
class.description: A graph script holds functions, variables and signals. A function is a set of steps joined by wires. A flow wire says which step runs next. A data wire carries a value from one step to another. A graph script attaches to an entity like any other script. It runs when it is attached and a function is called on it. Its [member base_type] says which class it extends. Every edit method changes one thing and returns an [enum Error]. When the edit fails, the script stays as it was and nothing is emitted. When it works, the script compiles again, running instances update and [signal Resource.changed] is emitted. The methods take and return text for anything that is not a string, a number or a bool, so a caller that only passes those types can use all of them. A text value is written the way [method @GlobalScope.var_to_str] writes it. Each function starts at an [code]entry[/code] step. A function stops with an error when it runs more steps in one resume than the [member ProjectSettings.graph_script/runtime/step_budget] allows. A step that waits, such as a delay, hands the caller a [GraphCall] instead of a result.

method.name: add_function
method.description: Adds an empty function called [param name]. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the name is not a valid identifier, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a function has that name.

method.name: add_signal
method.description: Adds a signal called [param name] with no arguments. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the name is not a valid identifier, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a signal has that name. Set its arguments with [method set_signal_arguments].

method.name: add_step
method.description: Adds a step of the given [param kind] to [param function], with the number [param id]. Use [method get_valid_step_id] to get a free number. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param id] is below 1 or the kind is unknown, [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when the number is taken, or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the function is missing. Use [method find_steps] to list the kinds.

method.name: add_variable
method.description: Adds a variable called [param name] of the given Variant [param type]. Its default is the default value of that type. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the name is not valid or the type is not a Variant type, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a variable has that name.

method.name: connect_steps
method.description: Joins output [param from_port] of [param from_step] to input [param to_port] of [param to_step] in [param function]. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when a step or the function is missing, [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the two ports do not fit or both ends are the same step, [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when the wire is already there, [constant ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE] when the data input already has a wire, or [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when a step has a kind the engine does not know.

method.name: disconnect_steps
method.description: Removes the wire from output [param from_port] of [param from_step] to input [param to_port] of [param to_step] in [param function]. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when there is no such wire.

method.name: find_overrides
method.description: Returns a JSON array of the virtual functions that this script can override, for its [member base_type]. A script with no base type is offered what an [Object] can override. Each entry is an object with [code]kind[/code], [code]group[/code], [code]label[/code] and [code]parameters[/code], like the entries of [method find_steps]. Choosing an entry means adding a function named by its [code]label[/code]. The list is empty in a build without debug features.

method.name: find_steps
method.description: Returns a JSON array of the steps that a person can add, best match first. Each entry is an object with [code]kind[/code], [code]group[/code], [code]label[/code] and [code]parameters[/code]. With an empty [param text] it lists the step kinds of the engine. With text it lists the kinds that match, then the methods, properties, signals and classes of the engine that match. [param dragged_side] narrows the list to steps that a dragged wire can reach. It is [code]""[/code] for no filter, [code]"input"[/code] when the wire comes from an input, or [code]"output"[/code] when it comes from an output. [param type] is the Variant type that a dragged data wire carries, and [constant TYPE_NIL] fits any. [param sort] is [code]"flow"[/code] or [code]"data"[/code] and says which sort of port the wire comes from. A value that is not one of these prints an error and returns an empty string.

method.name: get_document
method.description: Returns the whole script as text, in the format of an [code].ograph[/code] file. The same text is what saving the script writes.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns the first error found when the script was last compiled, or an empty string when it compiled with no error. The error names the function and the step. A function with an error does not run.

method.name: get_payload
method.description: Returns a copy of some steps of [param function] as JSON text, ready to hand to [method paste_payload] on this script or another one. [param ids_text] is a text array of step numbers, such as [code]"[2, 3]"[/code]. The copy holds those steps, the wires between them, and the variables and signals they use. It names the functions they call. Returns an empty string when the function is missing, [param ids_text] is not an array, or none of the numbers is a step. The [code]entry[/code] step cannot be copied.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns the functions, variables, signals and base type as one text. Pass the text to [method restore_snapshot] to return the script to this state. An undo history is made from these texts.

method.name: get_valid_step_id
method.description: Returns a step number that no step of [param function] uses, or [code]-1[/code] when the function is missing.

method.name: get_warnings
method.description: Returns an array of dictionaries, one per warning. A warning does not stop a function from running. Each dictionary has these keys: [code]kind[/code], [code]function[/code], [code]step[/code], [code]name[/code] and [code]text[/code]. [code]kind[/code] is [code]"unused_variable"[/code], [code]"unused_local"[/code], [code]"unreachable_step"[/code] or [code]"shadowed_name"[/code]. [code]function[/code] is empty and [code]step[/code] is [code]-1[/code] when the warning does not belong to one function or step. A name that starts with an underscore is never reported as unused.

method.name: move_step
method.description: Puts step [param id] of [param function] at the position ([param x], [param y]) on the canvas. The position is only for the editor. It does not change how the function runs. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: paste_payload
method.description: Pastes steps from [method get_payload] into [param function], with the top left of the steps at ([param x], [param y]). The pasted steps get new numbers. Returns JSON text of an object with three keys. [code]error[/code] is an [enum Error] value, [code]conflicts[/code] is an array and [code]steps[/code] is the array of new step numbers. The payload brings the variables and signals its steps use. When this script already has one with the same name and another definition, nothing is pasted and [code]error[/code] is [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS]. [code]conflicts[/code] then lists each clash. Call again with [param conflict] set to [code]"reuse"[/code] to use this script's own, or [code]"keep_both"[/code] to add the pasted one under a new name. [param conflict] is empty for the first try. A function that the payload calls and this script lacks is added empty. Other errors are [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] when the text is not a payload, [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the function is missing, and [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param conflict] is not one of the three values or the payload has a [code]return[/code] step and the function has no [code]entry[/code] step. The whole paste is one change. It either all happens or none of it does.

method.name: remove_frame
method.description: Removes comment frame [param id] from [param function]. The steps inside it stay. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: remove_function
method.description: Removes the function called [param name], with its steps. Steps that call it stay, and the call fails when it runs. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: remove_signal
method.description: Removes the signal called [param name]. Steps that use it stay, and they fail when they run. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: remove_step
method.description: Removes step [param id] and every wire that touches it from [param function]. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: remove_variable
method.description: Removes the variable called [param name]. Steps that read or write it stay, and the script does not compile until they change. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: rename_function
method.description: Renames a function and every step that calls it. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when no function has the name [param name], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param new_name] is not a valid identifier, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a function already has [param new_name].

method.name: rename_signal
method.description: Renames a signal and every step that uses it. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when no signal has the name [param name], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param new_name] is not a valid identifier, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a signal already has [param new_name].

method.name: rename_variable
method.description: Renames a variable and every step that reads or writes it. A running instance loses the value it held under the old name. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when no variable has the name [param name], [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param new_name] is not a valid identifier, or [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] when a variable already has [param new_name].

method.name: restore_snapshot
method.description: Replaces the functions, variables, signals and base type with those of a text from [method get_snapshot]. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] when the text is not a snapshot. Nothing changes after an error.

method.name: set_frame
method.description: Adds or replaces a comment frame in [param function]. [param frame_text] is the text of a dictionary with the keys [code]id[/code], [code]title[/code], [code]x[/code], [code]y[/code], [code]width[/code], [code]height[/code] and [code]collapsed[/code]. A frame is a box drawn behind steps. It has no effect on how the function runs. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] when the text cannot be read, [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] when it is not a frame or has no area, or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the function is missing.

method.name: set_signal_arguments
method.description: Sets the arguments of signal [param name]. [param arguments_text] is a text array with one entry per argument, each a dictionary with [code]name[/code] and [code]type[/code]. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the signal is missing, [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] when the text cannot be read, or [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] when an entry is not a name and a type.

method.name: set_step_parameter
method.description: Sets the parameter [param parameter] of step [param id] in [param function] to the value written in [param value_text]. A parameter is a value typed on the step, such as the name of a variable or the text to print. Wires that no longer fit the changed step are removed. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] when [param value_text] cannot be read, [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the step or function is missing, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param parameter] is empty or is [code]"pins"[/code]. Use [method set_step_pins] to change the number of pins.

method.name: set_step_pins
method.description: Sets how many pins a step has, for a kind that can grow, such as a sequence with more than two outputs. Wires on pins past the new count are removed. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when the step or function is missing, [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when the kind is unknown, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the kind cannot grow or [param count] is below the smallest count or above the largest.

method.name: set_variable_default
method.description: Sets the value a new instance starts with for variable [param name]. [param value_text] is written the way [method @GlobalScope.var_to_str] writes a value. Its type must match the type of the variable, unless the variable has no type and holds any value. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST], [constant ERR_PARSE_ERROR] when the text cannot be read, or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when the type differs.

method.name: set_variable_exported
method.description: Sets whether variable [param name] shows in the inspector of an entity that has this script. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: set_variable_hint
method.description: Sets the property hint of variable [param name] to [param hint], a [enum PropertyHint] value, with [param hint_string] as its text. The inspector uses it to pick an editor, such as a range slider. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST], or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param hint] is not a hint.

method.name: set_variable_info
method.description: Sets the category and the description of variable [param name]. The inspector groups exported variables by category and shows the description as a tooltip. Returns [constant OK] or [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST].

method.name: set_variable_type
method.description: Sets the Variant type of variable [param name]. The default value resets to the default of the new type when the type changes. Returns [constant OK], [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST], or [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] when [param type] is not a Variant type.

members.member: The name of the class this script extends. A script with no base type extends [Object]. It decides which virtual functions [method find_overrides] offers.

The functions of the script, as an array of dictionaries. Each has [code]name[/code], [code]steps[/code], [code]wires[/code] and [code]frames[/code]. Setting it replaces every function. A value that is not a valid list of functions prints an error and changes nothing. Use the edit methods to change one thing.

The signals of the script, as an array of dictionaries. Each has a [code]name[/code] and its [code]arguments[/code]. Setting it replaces every signal. A value that is not a valid list of signals prints an error and changes nothing.

The variables of the script, as an array of dictionaries. Each has [code]name[/code], [code]type[/code], [code]default[/code] and [code]exported[/code], and may have [code]hint[/code], [code]hint_string[/code], [code]category[/code] and [code]description[/code]. Setting it replaces every variable. A value that is not a valid list of variables prints an error and changes nothing.
